blurb: Climbnasium offers indoor climbing on walls up to 40 ft for top rope climbing and up to 14 ft for bouldering. Bouldering requires no ropes and has padded flooring. Top rope climbing requires two people and instruction for belaying is provided at scheduled times.
extraNote: No reservations required except for groups · Late arrival to belay class means waiting for next class or bouldering · Membership cancellation requires 5 days notice before 1st of month
